text: I feel curious and alert in this modern, almost clinical environment. The bright lights and sharp lines make me aware of my own sense of order and purpose, though there’s a subtle unease in the sterility and emptiness. Entering the R+D space, I am drawn into a realm dedicated to progress and thought, and I feel a sense of excitement mingled with humility—reminded of the vast terrain of knowledge that lies ahead, beckoning me to understand more deeply.
